name: Impacto
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished background illustration for an original collectible game card, portrait 2:3. Create a spectacular hand-inked comic-book action backdrop for a playful ducks-versus-household-robots game. NO CHARACTERS, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO UI badges. This is a production art layer: the original character will be composited later. Full-bleed warm turquoise sky, ivory yellow explosive central burst, rusty orange fragments, sharp navy ink contours, carefully controlled halftone screenprint dots and hand drawn speedlines. Dynamic radial composition with brightest near-empty area at center (50%,42%). Ground line at 72% height. Lower 24% becomes deep petrol navy with irregular torn explosion edge, quiet enough for large name lettering and ability icons to be added. Outer edges feature selective dimensional chrome-like machine fragments and bolts, no enclosing rectangle border. Strong polished graphic craft; artwork should feel printed with rich spot inks. Flat front view, not a photographed card or mockup, no background around the canvas. Exact clean 2:3 portrait composition.

name: Oficina encantada
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished hand-painted collectible game card background plate, portrait 2:3. NO CHARACTERS, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO ICONS. Bespoke whimsical cartoon game art. A lovingly handmade tiny puppet theater built from salvaged painted teal wood, warm brass corner fittings, chunky screws, a red cloth awning high at the top, leather straps, subtle scuffs, convincing painted bevels and contact shadows. Frame fills the canvas edges, front-on straight view with zero perspective skew. Inside the frame is a sunny cream-orange workshop light with distant simplified shed shapes low on the horizon; the middle 70% of the card must be clear and calm for inserting an existing character. Character stage from y20% to y70%, strong warm focal light. At y73%-83% a broad BLANK cream painted wooden plank for future name lettering. Bottom y84%-96% a dark desaturated teal recessed painted panel, empty for future ability symbols. No individual stat sockets; those are added separately. Playful premium tabletop tactility, painterly edge highlights, hand-inked outlines matching a bold cartoon mascot. Not medieval fantasy, no jewels, no ornamental gold filigree.

name: Onda pirata
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original high-end screenprinted collectible card background, portrait 2:3. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO CHARACTERS, no readable logos. A bold retrofuturist pirate-radio broadcast print for a humorous ducks vs robots card battler. Deep aubergine ink, fluorescent persimmon orange, pale lavender, warm cream. Huge interrupted concentric broadcast circles occupy the upper two-thirds; energetic diagonal paper cuts and rough screenprint edges, tiny hand-inked mechanical orbit marks only near the outer edges. Central broad pale cream oval provides quiet clean room for a character to be pasted in later. The image is a beautiful tactile risograph print, very subtle physical paper grain, ink misregistration restricted to outer shapes, strong intentionally designed composition. Bottom quarter is solid aubergine with a sweeping orange slanted band reserved for future title; no grid or dashboard, no rectangular UI boxes, no digital glow. Art directed commercial game graphic, unique silhouette language, no copying any existing game. Full-bleed flat portrait artwork with no surrounding mockup.

name: Liga de lata
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: professional illustrated card backing for a playful sports-league ducks and robots battler, portrait 2:3. NO CHARACTERS, TEXT, LETTERS, NUMBERS OR SYMBOLS. Original thick enamel toy collectible with a strong rounded shield-shaped inner composition, ivory ceramic border, brushed dark petrol metal, cherry-red lacquer accents and a few champagne aluminum trim strips. A stylized stadium or derby arena with curved perspective track and blurred warm floodlights surrounds a broad uncluttered pale aqua central space for a character. Card viewed absolutely head-on, no perspective skew of the overall card. Top 14% quiet ivory enamel for name lettering to be overlaid. Upper-middle 15%-74% reserved for original character. Bottom 22% is sculpted dark navy and ivory divided pediment, broad empty surface for stats and ability later. Carefully painted metallic reflections and rivets feel like a deluxe vintage tin toy, not a sci-fi HUD, not a website interface. High quality stylized game illustration, thick clean edges and intentional material lighting. Entire canvas filled by card, no mockup environment.

name: Teatro de papel
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high fidelity original papercraft collectible card background, portrait 2:3. No characters, no text, no numbers, no letters or UI icons. A dimensional hand-cut paper theater for a mischievous duck and robot adventure. Intricate but restrained overlapping layers of coral-red card stock, midnight blue backing, warm ochre and turquoise paper, sweeping scalloped arch, little cut-paper feathers and cog-like floral shapes at the corners. The internal central stage is pale warm ivory with sparse blue watercolor clouds, absolutely uncluttered from x15% to85%, y20% to70% for a character that will be inserted later. Hand inked dark edges, real subtle paper grain, beautiful shallow cast shadows between layers, original commercial indie game art. Bottom quarter: a large asymmetric ivory torn-paper banner spanning nearly full width for the future title, below it a quiet dark indigo strip for the future skill symbols. No rectangular panels, no ornate fantasy gold, no photorealism, no surrounding backdrop. Flat head-on production graphic, no overall perspective skew. Rich charming dimensional silhouette, every detail feels cut by an artist.
